sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md section 1.1 (Renewal theory for cast + auto timing schedules)
sources_quoted.quote: Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (`_schedule_shared_casts`).
sources_quoted.note: Establishes that opening-rotation cast epochs are driven by the sourced cast times, not by ability durations.

sources_quoted.quote: ... with the empowered basic-attack replacement landing at its sourced 0.25s cast time.
sources_quoted.note: Corpus-wide precedent for the convention: a cast started at t=0 with a 0.25 s sourced cast time authors its damage event at t = 0.25.

sources_quoted.note: The only 5-second quantity anywhere in Syndra's cached wiki text. It is a maximum recast WINDOW, not a damage delay.

independent_computation.step_1_cast_epochs: Shared-timeline rule (S3): the opening custom cast order is issued back-to-back, each cast occupying its sourced cast time. Syndra's sourced cast times (S1, S2) are Q = 0, W = 0, E = 0.25, R = 0.25. So an opening order issued at t = 0 places every zero-cast-time ability (Q, its 40-splinter second charge Q2, W) at t = 0, and the first ability carrying a cast time lands its damage at t = 0 + 0.25 = 0.25 s (S4 convention: damage lands at cast start + sourced cast time).
independent_computation.step_2_event_count_before_index_6: At splinters = 60 (S9) the opening authors, in order: Q (1 event, t=0), Q2 second charge (1 event, t=0), W magic (1 event) and W 60-splinter bonus true damage (1 event) at t=0, then the 0.25 s-cast ability. R alone contributes >=3 simultaneous per-sphere events (S10). Four events at t = 0 plus the 0.25 s cast block therefore puts indices 4,5,6 inside the 0.25 s block. damage_events[6] (0-based, the 7th event) falls on the third event of that block.
independent_computation.step_3_value: t(damage_events[6]) = 0 (rotation start) + 0.25 s (sourced cast time of E / R) = 0.25 s.
independent_computation.step_4_falsify_5.0: Search of Syndra's entire cached wiki text for a 5-second quantity returns exactly one hit: W's hold duration (S5). It is a maximum recast window, and the wiki states that at its expiry Syndra RELEASES the held target (S6) - i.e. at t = 5.0 s W deals no damage at all. No other sourced Syndra quantity yields 5.0 s: Q sphere delay 0.6 s, Q/R sphere lifetime 6 s, E stun 1.25 s, W slow 1.5 s, P collection 0.6 s / 4 s window. Base cooldowns are Q 7 (rechargeRate 7), W 12/11/10/9/8, E 15, R 120/100/80 - none equals 5.0 at zero ability haste. Therefore 5.0 s is not a sourced damage-event time for this fight.
independent_computation.conclusion: 0.25 s is the only value at this leaf that is derivable from the cached wiki data plus the documented shared-timeline / cast-time convention. The new value is correct.

alternative_reading_tested.hypothesis: '_60' denotes 60 ability haste rather than 60 splinters, in which case old 5.0 could be a legitimate SECOND W cast: cd' = 8 * 100/(100+60) = 5.0 s exactly (S7, S8) at W rank 5.
alternative_reading_tested.assessment: Arithmetically exact, so it cannot be excluded from data/ alone. But it does not overturn the verdict: under that reading the leaf diff is a re-index (extra opening events - the 60-splinter W true-damage event and/or the per-sphere R events - pushed the W recast past index 6), and index 6 then legitimately lands inside the 0.25 s cast block computed above. Under either reading 0.25 s is a sourced, valid damage-event time and 5.0 s is not one for index 6. Naming evidence favours the splinters reading: 60 is the module's own splinters threshold for W true damage (S9), and an ability-haste knob would conventionally be spelled 'ah60'.
alternative_reading_tested.residual_uncertainty: The scenario definition itself lives outside the permitted evidence tree (scripts/), so the exact cast order, fight length and sphere count were not read. The verdict rests on: 0.25 s is sourced and reachable; 5.0 s is not sourced as a damage instant (S5, S6).

verdict_reason: new_value_correct - 0.25 s is exactly the sourced cast time of Syndra's E (Scatter the Weak) and R (Unleashed Power) in data/champions.json, and the shared-timeline convention in docs/math-foundations.md section 1.1 plus the corpus precedent in data/champion-audit/batch-p1-3.json place that cast's damage at cast start + 0.25 s. The old 5.0 s matches nothing in Syndra's cached wiki text except Force of Will's 5-second HOLD window, which the same cache says ends in a release with no damage.
